authors: Meta Generated Brain, Atomo, Avetixz, Bcz_mvn, Fresh Bread (stefnej), Inferno, Juliette, MrPotota (KLYDOXOPE), ShadowGrif, Smaguy

metas.name: Architecture - Aceh Mosques
metas.note: Aceh is a uniquely autonomous province and the only one where Sharia Law is officially applied. Mosques are, therefore, more common, large and ornate in this region than other parts of Indonesia.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Belitung Sheet Metal Roofs
metas.note: Belitung Island, on the other hand, mainly has sheet metal roofs, which can be either a fresh silver colour or show signs of rust.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Black Walls Bright Rocks
metas.note: Black walls with light-coloured rocks are common on Kundur Island and Karimunbesar Island.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Boat Shaped Houses
metas.note: In addition to the palm-wood houses, there are also the well-known traditional Batak boat-shaped houses in the Lake Toba area. Most of the houses have highly recognisable criss-crossed stilts.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Circular Vents
metas.note: In the Riau Islands as well as in Northern Sumatra, houses often feature circular or semi-circular vents and windows with “spokes” radiating out from the centre . These are typically featured on the gable or above doors and windows. Similar windows and vents can be found elsewhere in Sumatra.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Extended Bamboo Fences
metas.note: Conspicuously long bamboo fences, usually laid horizontally, are commonly used to demarcate properties within villages in Bengkulu, and are also frequently found in rural areas. Vertically oriented bamboo fences are also common.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Floral Antlers
metas.note: These gable horns with rich floral patterns that resemble antlers are found mostly in Riau and on the Riau Islands. These gable horns will often be seen accompanied by similar floral decorations on the gable itself.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Floral Gable Motifs
metas.note: In Jambi, Riau and also Batam and Bintan, intertwining floral patterns on house gables are common.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Gate Pillars Bengkulu
metas.note: In Bengkulu, you will rarely find isolated pillars with a floral motif on top at property entrances.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Gate Pillars Lampung
metas.note: Property entrances in Lampung also frequently feature rectangular stone pillars, often decorated, and a concrete kerb.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Gate Pillars South Sumatra & Jambi
metas.note: Entrance pillars can be found in South Sumatra and Jambi, usually taking a turret shape with a rising balustrade attached.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Hipped Rusty Roofs
metas.note: Roofs in West Sumatra are typically low, hipped, and have a dark rusty colour, often with multiple trapezoid sections.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Jambi Gables
metas.note: In Jambi, you'll commonly find pointy saddle roofs, consisting of a steep top part and a more shallow flap. These often have simple X-shaped or hook-shaped gable horns attached.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Jambi Hooks
metas.note: In Jambi, you can find gable horns consisting of two hooks with downward-pointing ends.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Karimunbesar Modern Row-Houses
metas.note: New residential areas with rows of modern houses and paved with hexagonal paving stones are common on Karimunbesar Island.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Karo Crown Roofs
metas.note: The Batak Karo people in the north of North Sumatra province often construct houses with unique, highly ornate crowns, consisting of four-way gables topped off with buffalo head finials. Both modern and traditional varieties of this design exist.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Lampung Tiles
metas.note:
Historic migration from Java has left a mark on architecture in Lampung.

Traditional Javanese tiles are common here, however the population density in Lampung is much lower, resulting in larger plots of land and widely spaced houses.

Lampung roofs often have tiles of different shades, from light orange to dark brown. There are also more houses built of wood in Lampung.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Limas Roofs
metas.note: Limas houses are found in a narrow area in the Musi Banyuasin Regency. A characteristic feature of this house type is a top section that gradually descends forming a long street-facing extension.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Loose Stone Piles
metas.note: Loose piles of stones are common in Bengkulu villages. Combined with the moss gardens this can be a good indication of the province.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Low Stilt Houses
metas.note: In coastal areas of north-east Sumatra (mainly Riau and Jambi), you can find low-stilt houses. In the north they are usually elevated by concrete frustums while wooden stilts are found further south.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Mandailing Roofs
metas.note: In Mandailing Natal Regency, you will find houses with ornate gables and strikingly long gabled horns on large roofs. These are called Bagas Godang Panyabungan Tonga and are associated with the Batak Mandailing people.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Metal Gable Ends
metas.note: In Bengkulu, houses often have clean corrugated metal gables, often coloured crimson or blue.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Moss-Like Lawns
metas.note: In Bengkulu you can often find front gardens covered with moss-like lawns.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Multi-Layered Gables With Notches
metas.note: Gables in Bengkulu are also frequently multi-layered, with notches or semi-circle patterns in the top layer. Similar notches specifically can rarely occur in other regions such as North Kalimantan and West Sulawesi.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Nias Chief Houses
metas.note: The Omo Sebua Chief’s House, built on pillars with towering thatched roofs (or sheet metal roofs in modern versions), is characteristic of Nias Island. It is particularly common in the southern half of the island.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Nias Churches & Property Graves
metas.note: The vast majority of the population of Nias Island are adherents of Protestant Christianity. Churches are common and graves on private property are not unusual.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Nias Flap Roofs
metas.note: Everyday houses with roofs that curve outwards to the side can be found as detached houses or in rows of houses in the southern half of Nias Island. The roof shape is a partial imitation of the Chief's House.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Nias Gable Windows
metas.note: On Nias Island, you will commonly find houses that have windows in the gable end with wooden shutters that swing open.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Nias Rounded Houses
metas.note: In the northern half of Nias Island, chieftain houses found have roofs with a significantly more rounded shape.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Nias Thatched Roofs
metas.note: Another widespread type of house on Nias Island is simple houses built from wooden planks and equipped with thatched roofs and thatched canopies over the front. The same combination of thatched roofs and canopies can also be found on other islands in Indonesia, but usually in different shapes.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Palembang Silver Roofs
metas.note: The area south of Palembang is full of swamps. Stilt houses with hip metal roofs are common here.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Red Bricks Narrow
metas.note:
Red bricks are very common in Sumatra and are helpful in regionguessing or excluding specific parts of the island. They occur in two variants: narrow and wide.

Narrow red bricks are found in the northern and southern parts of Sumatra, as well as all along the west coast.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Red Bricks Wide
metas.note:
Red bricks are very common in Sumatra and are helpful in regionguessing or excluding specific parts of the island. They occur in two variants: narrow and wide.

Wide red bricks are found in the centre-south, primarily in South Sumatra and Jambi.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Red Stone Walls
metas.note: Low walls made of these dark red stones can be found along property borders, mostly in the south of Bintan Island, as well as very rarely on Batam Island.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Ridge Tiles Grey-Black
metas.note: Roofs similar to those found in Bangka Island are very common in the Riau Islands. These roofs typically consist of fibre cement sheets with grey tiles lining the edges.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Ridge Tiles Red
metas.note: Red tiles along the edges of fibre cement roofs make houses on Bangka Island easily recognisable. Fully tiled roofs are also common.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Rising Roofs
metas.note: Smaller structures in North Sumatra will often feature a variation of the gable design with a jagged boat roof, as opposed to the smoother curve. The rising section can be found on one or both ends of the roof.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Spired Roofs
metas.note: In West Sumatra, you will often find houses with a boat-shaped roof—frequently multi-tiered—featuring soaring spires at the gable ends, giving them a majestic appearance.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Stone Lamps
metas.note: Stone lamps are common at entrances in Lampung as well as in adjacent parts of South Sumatra.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Sumatra Roofs Sheet Metal
metas.note: South Sumatra houses with sheet metal roofs (often with a dark rust-brown tone) are found in the interior, mountainous parts of the province, and can be found also in western Jambi.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Architecture - Sumatra Roofs Tiled
metas.note:
South Sumatra has very unique houses which typically consist of a top floor with many windows, serving as the main floor, built on top of a lower section which may sometimes just consist of stilts or pillars. A staircase leads to the top section. The whole house is built of timber.

Combined with a hip roof made of traditional tiles, this type of house is very recognisable.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Culture - Siger Crown Symbol
metas.note: The Siger crown is a symbol of Lampung. Its design features a curved shape with seven or nine peaks. It can be found on gates, lamps, bridge stones, street signs and in other places.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Bangka Quadpod
metas.note: Another very good identifying feature for Bangka Island is satellite dishes with metal quadpod mounts. On Belitung Island, satellite dishes are mounted on metal poles.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Batam City Plumbing Ads
metas.note: Throughout Batam city, you will find utility poles covered with small metal signs advertising plumbing services. They often feature the phrases “SEDOT WC”, “WASTAFEL”, and/or “MAMPET.” These are extremely common in Batam but can also rarely appear in Bintan.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Batam Electrical Logo
metas.note: Batam Island's electricity provider, Bright PLN, uses this orange and white logo. In addition to appearing on electricity meter boxes, this logo can be spotted from a distance on the sides of other electrical infrastructure on the island.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Bintan Electrical Boxes
metas.note:
Electrical boxes painted blue and white or blue and yellow can be used to identify Bintan Island over Batam Island.

Blue and white electrical boxes are unique to Bintan, whereas blue and yellow electrical boxes, while widespread in other parts of Indonesia, are not found on Batam Island. Note that plain beige or black electrical boxes also appear on both islands.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Bintan Street Sign
metas.note: These distinctive decorations on top of street signs are found on Bintan Island, mostly in and around Tanjung Pinang.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Dumai Rupat Street Signs
metas.note: This street sign design consisting of three sections, with an emblem and an earth logo (possibly in a different layout) is found in the coastal city of Dumai. A similar design can be found on Rupat Island.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Kilometre Markers  Black Border
metas.note: Kilometre markers with a black border can be found on the Pekanbaru-Dumai Highway, which cuts across hills of dense oil palm plantations. Note the southernmost section of road does not use this design.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Kilometre Markers "S"
metas.note: This highway in North Sumatra shown on the map can be recognised by the additional "S" on the right-hand side of kilometre markers.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Kilometre Markers Mounted
metas.note: The Kisaran-Indrapura Highway has kilometre markers mounted on on bent rods jutting out into the central reservation.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Lampung Pavement
metas.note: Lampung pavement typically consists of random, irregular rocks of uneven sizes, often paired with reddish soil.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Lampung Sticks
metas.note: Medium-sized sticks frequently serve as bollards along streets in Lampung. They can rarely be found elsewhere. Red and white sticks are common for these bollards but the colour may vary.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Minas Oil Field
metas.note: Situated in a hilly landscape, Minas oil field is currently the largest oil field in Indonesia. Numerous unpaved paths with oil pipelines running alongside them cross dense oil palm plantations in this area.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Oil Industry
metas.note: Oil wells are mainly found in the heavily industrial province of Riau. As a result you will often find gas pipelines, oil pumps, and oil tankers here.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Red Pole Spikes
metas.note: Dark red pole spikes are specific to Bintan Island.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Urban Aceh
metas.note:
The northeastern part of Aceh around Langsa appears quite urban with a lot of road traffic.

Poles have three or four crossbars which is unusual for Indonesia.

Boxy tuk-tuks can be seen in Langsa but can also rarely be found elsewhere in Aceh.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Infrastructure - Yellow Numbers Black Background
metas.note: Pipelines in Riau can also help narrow down the location. For example, this pipe with ring-like sections and yellow numbers in the format 'XX.XXX' on a black background can be seen on the stretch of road shown on the map.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Aceh Valley
metas.note: In central Aceh, there is coverage in a long, NW-SE oriented valley coming from north Sumatra. The landscape resembles that of Lake Toba, with high mountains visible to the side of the valley.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Barren Tree Mountains
metas.note: The landscape around Lake Toba is unique, featuring grass-covered mountains dotted with trees. Due to its higher elevation, the clouds sometimes appear quite low.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Batam Bintan Red Soil
metas.note: Soil will usually be red on both Batam Island and Bintan Island.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Coastal Jambi
metas.note: In coastal Jambi you can also find many canals lined with areca palms.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Coastal Plains
metas.note: North of Pariaman is a flat plain (uncharacteristic for the west coast), with many oil palm plantations as well as groves of coconut and areca palms.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Eucalyptus Plantations
metas.note: Large eucalyptus plantations define the landscape of coastal Jambi.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Gunung Bintan Besar
metas.note: Gunung Bintan Besar (“Mount Bintan”) is the highest point on Bintan Island and can be recognised at a considerable distance with its distinct pyramidal shape.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Gunung Kerinci
metas.note: To the north of the regency, you can find the magnificent Gunung Kerinci located in the middle of the Sumatran range on the border between Jambi and West Sumatra. It is surrounded by a relatively flat volcanic field, itself surrounded by non-volcanic hills. Mulch films and tea plantations can sometimes be seen.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Harau Valley
metas.note: The Harau Valley just north of Payakumbuh is a unique karst landscape with tall exposed rock faces, often with red soil along the bottom.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Kaolin Extraction
metas.note: The red soil prevalent on both islands is often mixed with white kaolin (limestone). Kaolin mining areas can be found on both Bangka Island and Belitung Island.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Kerinci Valley
metas.note: The Kerinci Regency is located in a NW-SE oriented valley with vast expanses of rice fields between mountains on both sides. The region contains a large number of the hip-roof houses commonly seen in the west of Sumatra. Poles here are somewhat similar to those in West Sumatra.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Kundur Karimunbesar Yellowish Soil
metas.note: The islands of Kundur and Karimunbesar in the Riau Islands have strikingly yellow soil, which is reflected in a local architecture featuring yellowish-grey bricks. These can be mistaken for similar bricks in the Nusas.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Lake Danau Maninjau
metas.note: Lake Danau Maninjau west of Bukittinggi is situated inside a large caldera (Maninjau Caldera) surrounded by tall walls of mountains from all sides. It's also a well-known tourist attraction for its distinct scenery.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Lake Danau Singkarak
metas.note: Lake Danau Singkarak is situated at the centre of West Sumatra, sandwiched between low NW-SE mountains on both sides.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Moisty West
metas.note: The towering Barisan Mountains in West Sumatra catch most of the moist air currents from the Indian Ocean, creating heavy precipitation on the eastern side of the mountains. The province therefore has some of the highest rainfall in the country, appearing moist in most of the coverage.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Mount Sinabung
metas.note: Mount Sinabung is located 30 km northwest of Lake Toba, in Karo Regency. The volcano is cone-shaped, active, and has erupted several times in recent years. Its summit is almost devoid of vegetation and clearly visible from the surrounding area.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Red Hill Plantations
metas.note: The foothills of Bengkulu are dominated by a series of undulating red-soil hills upon which lie a wave of oil palm plantations and rubber trees.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Rural Batam Bintan
metas.note:
Rural landscapes on Bintan Island and Batam Island are broadly similar, although rarer on Batam Island since this island is more heavily developed.

Rural roadsides are often overgrown with ferns and other low groundcover. Low to modest hills are commonly visible and roads frequently cut through the hillsides leaving exposed red dirt slopes. This is especially common south of Batam.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Southwestern Aceh
metas.note: Several trails in the southwestern plains of Aceh have oil palm plantations and the landscape is similar to other western coastal areas of Sumatra. In areas closer to the mountains, ferns are often seen along the sides of the roads.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Landscape - Three Volcanoes
metas.note: The three volcanoes, Gunung Singgalang, Gunung Marapi and Gunung Sago, stand out from the central uplands of West Sumatra, and can be easily recognised in the nearby area, with Marapi being the tallest one, and Sago being rather less distinctive. Due to the moist climate of West Sumatra, they are often very shroudy.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - Bangka Belitung
metas.note: Bangka Island and Belitung Island often have a rural feel with trees and grass lining the road. Reeds are common and some roads appear red in colour (due to the soil).
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - Lake Toba Agriculture
metas.note: The Lake Toba area is dominated by small-scale agriculture with small garden-like fields and tea plantations. These are often lined with various flowers, in particular Clibadium surinamense (white), Mexican sunflowers (yellow) and hibiscus (red).
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - Sweet Potato Vines
metas.note: The sweet potato plant can be recognised by its small, green and dark purple leaves. It can be found covering large areas of ground all over Nias Island.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord

metas.name: Vegetation - West Basin Fields
metas.note: West Sumatra is a major rice-producing province, with fields mainly located in the basin around Payakumbuh as well as the surrounding valleys. You will also find fields south of Solok, particularly cabbage fields, typically covered with recognisable black foil.
metas.footer: Based on Real Meta Research Group Indonesia Guide Join our Discord Real Meta Research Group Discord
